# HELP leontp_leap_indicator The leap second warning given to NTP clients: 0 none, 1 a second to be added, 2 one to be dropped, 3 clock not set.
# TYPE leontp_leap_indicator gauge
leontp_leap_indicator 0

# HELP leontp_round_trip_seconds How long an NTP question and its answer spent on the network.

leontp_round_trip_seconds 0.013565941
# HELP leontp_status_flags A status byte the maker does not document, as a number: 1 on a healthy, locked unit.
# TYPE leontp_status_flags gauge
leontp_status_flags 1
# HELP leontp_stratum The stratum the time server gives NTP clients: 1 while it has a GPS fix or is holding over from one.
# TYPE leontp_stratum gauge
leontp_stratum 1

# TYPE leontp_up gauge
leontp_up 1
